requirement:
Saved execution-coverage checks compute line coverage from the union of
instrumented file-and-line locations in the selected fresh records under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection` and
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.freshness`, including child processes.
Each location counts once in the denominator and is covered when any selected
record has a positive execution count. Percentages use these union counts,
rather than averaging process reports. A selection containing no instrumented
lines, or incomplete measurements, is unavailable under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.measurement`; otherwise absent
file or function measurements remain subject to their coverage obligations.
rationale:
The reviewed tests adequately cover `requirements.test-coverage.index.summary`. I did not request any implementation source.

**Union across selected fresh records, including child processes**
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source]` records two tests with complementary covered and uncovered locations. It asserts the union marks both locations covered, so a location is covered when any selected record has a positive count.
- The same test makes stale records ineligible after the source changes. A newer record from a different build leaves only that record selected. This applies the `index.freshness` and `index.selection` limits to the union inputs.
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[saved_reports_preserve_profiles_sources_and_child_union]` adds a child process whose counts are the inverse of the parent's. It asserts the combined covered count exceeds the parent's alone. It also covers a file that appears in only one record, and asserts the union has exactly three distinct locations. This shows each location is counted once rather than summed per process.
- `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[children_and_filtered_runs_contribute_to_the_same_union]` goes through the real check report. A parent and a child process each cover part of the lines, and the report shows full coverage with a denominator equal to the number of distinct lines. This shows the denominator is not doubled and the percentage is not an average of per-process reports. A second filtered record with all-zero counts leaves the result unchanged, so a zero-count record does not erase another record's execution.

**Unavailable measurements**
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[saved_measurement_failures_remain_unavailable_to_cli_checks]` covers these cases:
  - No saved coverage at all: the check does not pass.
  - Each incomplete-measurement variant: no processes, an attempt diagnostic, a process diagnostic, an uncaptured source file, an empty profile and a missing child profile. Each gives a failing report containing "missing or unreadable coverage".
  - A selection with no instrumented lines: the report contains "No usable instrumented lines".
- The first book test also checks that newer failed or interrupted attempts with missing coverage fail the check and do not fall back to older records. It also checks that stale records report "stale coverage".

**Absent file or function measurements**
These remain subject to their own obligations in `check.functions` and the file-coverage requirements. They are delegated to the tests for those requirements, and `children_and_filtered_runs_contribute_to_the_same_union` is also marked for `check.functions`.

**Gaps**
I found no obligation in the subject text that lacks a test with a relevant assertion. The cited selection, freshness and measurement requirements are context, and the tests apply them to the subject's case.

text: :::{req} index.summary
Saved execution-coverage checks compute line coverage from the union of
instrumented file-and-line locations in the selected fresh records under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection` and
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.freshness`, including child processes.
Each location counts once in the denominator and is covered when any selected
record has a positive execution count. Percentages use these union counts,
rather than averaging process reports. A selection containing no instrumented
lines, or incomplete measurements, is unavailable under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.measurement`; otherwise absent
file or function measurements remain subject to their coverage obligations.
:::{req} index.selection
Saved execution-coverage checks select the most recent recorded attempt
for each nextest binary and test name within the instrumented configuration
of the most recently started recorded attempt. Most recent refers to when an
attempt started, including failed or interrupted attempts. A newer filtered
run updates only tests it executes, leaving other compatible records available.
A newer attempt with missing or unreadable coverage is unavailable and does
not fall back to an older success. Incompatible configurations under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration` are excluded.
Selection uses recorded metadata without building or executing tests.
:::{req} index.freshness
Only records whose captured source inputs match the current source and
whose build configurations are compatible contribute counts to saved
execution-coverage checks under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`. Invalidated records or
records of unknown compatibility are identified as stale or unavailable and
excluded from combined totals. Per-process reports and matching captured
source remain retained until their build artifacts are removed.
:::{req} check.measurement
The coverage check MUST fail when no usable coverage has been collected, or when
a selected latest attempt has missing, unreadable, or stale coverage. It MUST
distinguish these measurement failures from measured lines with zero execution
and from individual functions absent from otherwise usable coverage. Exception
evidence MUST NOT excuse measurement failures or permit substitution of an
older attempt. Excluded historical runs and incompatible configurations MUST
NOT by themselves cause failure.
Coverage whose format does not support the function attribution required by
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.functions` MUST be rejected with guidance
to recollect coverage. When missing or corrupt metadata prevents establishing
the latest-per-test selection or active configuration, the check MUST fail
rather than silently use remaining records. Historical data MAY be disregarded
without failure only when its exclusion can be established.
